updates.title: Test site sandbox
updates.text: The test site now works fully without a server and has a sandbox panel for coins, scores, bots and owner tools.

updates.title: Bots in every test mode
updates.text: On the test site, bots now race against you in Race and fight alongside you in Adventure, and owner log images work there too.

updates.title: Smarter test bots and cannon fix
updates.text: The cannon is now only in War maps, not in Hide and Seek. On the test site, bots run and jump like players, the sandbox menu is easier to use, you can create and switch between any number of accounts, and the owner's Admin Abuse and Edit buttons are back.

updates.title: TestPanel
updates.text: The test site's sandbox menu is now called TestPanel.

updates.title: Test site fixes
updates.text: On the test site, Log out works and the sign-in window lets you pick or create a test account, Story Mode links, skins and Home links work inside the site's folder, and broken avatar images are gone.

updates.title: No more climbing walls from the side
updates.text: You can no longer hang on a block's edge and climb it from the side: blocks are only reached by jumping on top. Bots that seek turn blue and caught bots turn orange, hiding bots spread out across the map, the leaderboard's Today and This Week numbers are correct, and only the owner sees the Admin Abuse button.

updates.title: Aiming in War and smarter bots
updates.text: In War you now aim slings, bombs and fireballs with the mouse, with a crosshair and a dotted flight path; on phones weapons aim at the nearest enemy by themselves. On the test site, bots now really play: in War they pick up tokens, buy weapons and medkits, keep their distance, aim at you, man the cannons and avoid poison, and with bots you also get Team, Control Points and Bro RED rounds. In Capture the Flag bots steal and defend flags, in Domination they take points, and the Hide and Seek seeker searches hiding spots instead of seeing through walls.

updates.title: Phone aiming and a new Pirate Bay
updates.text: On phones you can now aim in War: hold your finger on the map to see the flight path, and let go to throw or fire a cannon there. The War panel on phones moved to the top so it no longer covers your fighter. The Pirate Bay map was redrawn: real ship hulls, cannons standing on the decks, water that looks like water and a palm island in the middle.
